name: Burton Sweet
evidence: Dedicated charity team and published charity accounts, audit, independent examination and advisory services.
contact: Josh Kingston, Director & Partner; Ed Marsh, Senior Charity Adviser
overview: Burton Sweet is a South West accountancy practice with a dedicated charities and civil society team. Its work includes charity accounts, external scrutiny and practical advice for trustees. It serves a range of charitable structures, with particular experience in faith-based organisations.

services.evidence: Preparation of charity financial statements and support with fund accounting.
Support applying the Charities SORP and preparing trustees’ annual reports.
Audit and assurance are included among its charity-sector services.
Independent examination by the firm’s charity team.
Charity-specific Corporation Tax, VAT and Gift Aid advice.
Bookkeeping, financial control and outsourced support for businesses and charities.
Support with charity financial controls and management accounts.
